purpose: Teach: 至極/入団/簡易裁判所/身動き/座標/品番/邦題/体勢

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会発表は至極好評だったぞ
lines.en: Ren—your conference presentation was extremely well-received.
lines.style: Calm, measured delivery with a slight pause after the name. Warm approval in the tone—not effusive, but genuine. The kind of praise that lands because it's earned and not overdone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室への入団を希望する学生が増えました
lines.en: Yes. We've had more students expressing interest in joining the lab.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. A touch of quiet pride underneath—he's aware this is good news but doesn't oversell it. Direct eye contact, slight nod of acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、係争事は簡易裁判所で解決した事例も学べ
lines.en: Ren—look into how dispute cases are resolved in small claims court too.
lines.style: Measured instruction, slightly forward-leaning. Not demanding, but expectant. The tone of someone who knows you can handle it and will follow through.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験中の身動きが取れない状況も学習しました
lines.en: Yes. I've also been learning how to manage constraints when experiments demand full attention.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful word choice. A quiet admission of difficulty beneath the compliance—he's been struggling but framing it as learning. Slight hesitation before the last phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、座標系の変換を確認しろ
lines.style: Brief, direct. No-nonsense instruction delivered with steady authority. Quick tempo, clipped at the end. The boss knows exactly what needs checking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試料の品番管理を徹底します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure our sample cataloguing system is airtight.
lines.style: Immediate agreement, then a shift to thoroughness. He's heard the real concern beneath the surface and is reassuring without being asked. Steady, confident delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外論文の邦題で発表しろ
lines.en: Ren—present your findings using the Japanese titles of the overseas papers.
lines.style: Clear directive with an expectation of precision. Not suggestion—instruction. Slight emphasis on 'Japanese titles' as though this detail matters more than it might first seem.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。発表時の体勢を意識して臨みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll pay attention to my posture and presence throughout the presentation.
lines.style: Determined, focused delivery. He's taking the instruction seriously—this is about more than words. Steady breath, slight nod. The closing tone is resolute.
